title: GPU OOM auto-fallback and kernel hard-fail handling
description:
## Goal

GPU stages **signal** OOM and kernel/driver errors via the typed
`StageError` enum and declare a compile-bound `Stage::CpuFallback`
associated type per Phase 0 §1 and §8. They do NOT implement the
CPU-fallback dispatch — that's the executor's job (`42eac5cc`).

## Context

Task under story `1f588e2a` (GPU stages) within epic `gf2-sim`
(`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §1 (associated-type fallback
shape, Q6) and §8 (failure-mode policy + seam decision). Wave B.3:
depends on `f6004add`, `a930be7f`, `d3f1616a`.

This is the "GPU error-SIGNALLING discipline" task: (1) audit hip call
sites, (2) verify `Stage::CpuFallback` declarations + presence test,
(3) build the reusable fault-injection test infrastructure, (4) ensure
the `strict_gpu` config field is present and honored at the error-
mapping boundary.

**AMENDMENT 2026-06-09 (user-approved scope correction — NO rigor change,
obligations MOVED to their owning nodes).** The audit found two
forward-referencing clauses that this B.3 task cannot complete because
they are delivered by downstream tasks; they are MOVED (not dropped) so
the end-to-end rigor is preserved:
- The fault injectors' **consumption** (driving the executor's
  OOM/kernel-error substitution test) is delivered by C.2 `42eac5cc`
  (whose deliverable-3 already injects via these injectors). This task
  delivers the injectors as the reusable SSOT and self-verifies they
  produce the correct error variants.
- The **`--strict-gpu` CLI flag** is delivered by the gf2-sim campaign
  binary in D.2 `bbf6b6ee`; the **executor's strict-gpu promotion**
  (OOM→`FatalError::OutOfMemory`) is delivered by C.2 `42eac5cc`. This
  task delivers the `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` field and confirms it
  is honored at the error-mapping boundary (`map_hip_error`/§8 doc).

## Deliverables

1. Audit + corrections across `gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/{alloc,launch,
   streams}.rs` and every Phase B GPU-stage wrapper
   (`gf2-sim/src/gpu/{awgn,ldpc_bp,demap,mod}.rs`):
   - Every `hipMalloc` failure path returns a typed `OutOfMemory`
     error; every post-launch kernel-error a typed `KernelLaunch`/
     `HipError::Hip`; **no `unwrap()`/`panic!` on a HIP error path.**
2. Verify every Phase B GPU stage declares a `Stage::CpuFallback`
   associated type and `cpu_fallback()` returns `Some(&self.fallback)`,
   for the REAL orphan-rule fallback types — `GpuAwgn`→`channels::Awgn`,
   `GpuLdpcBp`→`CpuLdpcBp`, `GpuGrayQamDemapper`→`CpuGrayQamDemapper`;
   verified by `tests/gpu_cpu_fallback_present.rs`.
3. Reusable fault-injection test infrastructure as the SSOT in
   `crates/gf2-sim/tests/common/mod.rs`:
   - `OomInjector` wraps a `Stage` and forces
     `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory` on the Nth invocation;
     `KernelErrorInjector` forces `FatalError::KernelLaunch`.
   - Test-only; placed in `tests/common/mod.rs` so `42eac5cc` reuses
     them via `mod common;` (no copy-paste). This task's own tests
     verify the injectors produce the expected error variants.
4. Confirm `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` exists and is honored at the
   gf2-sim↔HIP error-mapping boundary (§8). NOTE (per the 2026-06-09
   amendment): the `--strict-gpu` CLI flag is delivered by D.2
   `bbf6b6ee` and the executor's strict-gpu OOM-promotion by C.2
   `42eac5cc`; this task only ensures the config field + boundary doc.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Code audit: zero `unwrap()`/`panic!` on production HIP error
  paths in `gf2-kernels-hip/src/host/` or `gf2-sim/src/gpu/`.
- [hard] Every Phase B GPU stage's `Stage::CpuFallback` is declared and
  `cpu_fallback()` returns `Some(&self.fallback)` (real wrapper types);
  verified by `tests/gpu_cpu_fallback_present.rs`.
- [hard] The reusable fault-injection infrastructure
  (`OomInjector`/`KernelErrorInjector`) lives in `tests/common/mod.rs`
  as the SSOT, compiles in both hip and no-hip configs, and this task's
  own tests verify the injectors produce the expected
  `RecoverableError::OutOfMemory` / `FatalError::KernelLaunch` variants.
  (Their CONSUMPTION by the executor substitution test is a `[hard]`
  criterion on C.2 `42eac5cc` — moved there, not dropped.)
- [hard] `PipelineConfig::strict_gpu` is present and honored at the
  error-mapping boundary. (The `--strict-gpu` CLI flag is a `[hard]`
  criterion on D.2 `bbf6b6ee`; the executor strict-gpu promotion is a
  `[hard]` criterion on C.2 `42eac5cc` — both moved there, not dropped.)
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- This task does NOT implement the CPU-fallback DISPATCH — that lives
  in `42eac5cc`. Phase 0 design doc §8 owns the seam decision.
- No diagnostic-dump format (also `42eac5cc`).
- No new GPU stages (`f6004add`, `a930be7f`, `d3f1616a` cover Phase B).
